description: This Java class defines an event strategy for handling AclEntryCreated events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends a base strategy class and implements specific logic to set permissions on a ThingBuilder object using data from the event.

classes.name: AclEntryCreatedStrategy
classes.description: Implements a strategy to handle AclEntryCreated events by updating permissions on a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent(final AclEntryCreated event, final ThingBuilder.FromCopy thingBuilder)
methods.description: Processes the AclEntryCreated event to set permissions on the provided ThingBuilder.
